title: 184 East Royal Fern Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 184 East Royal Fern Way is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to 184 East Royal Fern Way, where coastal charm meets modern luxury in the sought-after Crossing District of WaterColor. This stunning four-bedroom plus bunk room retreat sleeps up to twelve guests and features a private pool and spa, open-concept interiors, and convenient access to Camp WaterColor, the Beach Club and Seaside.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with up to 12 Passes Included 6-Passenger Street Legal Electric Cart Included in Rental 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Private Pool and Spa (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) Exterior Shower Propane Grill Parking for 2 Vehicles 3-Minute Golf Cart Ride to Camp WaterColor 5-Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside 6-Minute Golf Cart Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access Experience the Home Your dream WaterColor escape begins at 184 East Royal Fern Way, a beautifully designed home offering elegant interiors and resort-style outdoor living. Professionally decorated and filled with natural light, this residence creates a relaxing and refined atmosphere perfect for family gatherings or group getaways. The open concept living area connects seamlessly to the dining space and gourmet kitchen, featuring bright white countertops, a large gas range, stainless-steel appliances, and a wine refrigerator. Whether preparing a simple breakfast or a celebratory dinner, the kitchen’s layout makes entertaining effortless. Guests can dine at the kitchen island, which seats four, or enjoy meals together at the nearby dining table. The first-floor primary suite offers a peaceful retreat, complete with an upholstered king bed, private bathroom with soaking tub and walk-in shower, and direct access to the outdoor living area. Upstairs, the second floor offers plenty of space for everyone. A luxurious king suite includes a private bathroom with soaking tub and walk-in shower, while two additional guest bedrooms, a queen room and a king room, each include private en suite bathrooms. A separate bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunk beds provides the perfect retreat for kids. Outside, unwind by your private pool and spa or grill dinner in the outdoor entertaining area. Ample seating invites poolside lounging by day and relaxed stargazing by night.With six adult bikes and a 6-passenger electric cart included, exploring WaterColor and nearby Seaside is simple and scenic. Whether riding to the Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, or local dining spots, 184 East Royal Fern Way delivers an exceptional coastal experience.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Half Bath Laundry Area Second Floor Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds (4) Half Bath Life in WaterColor From its location in the Crossing District, this home offers effortless access to Camp WaterColor, local shops, and the pristine beaches of 30A. With a private pool and spa, bikes, and an electric cart, 184 East Royal Fern Way ensures a luxurious yet laid-back WaterColor getaway.
